title: Demand forecasting dashboard for a retail startup
content: Built a FastAPI service and dashboard that consolidated weekly inventory data. The client accepted a two-week pilot and continued maintenance after handover.

title: Evidence-aware document search prototype
content: Implemented hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval with source links, simple claim checks, and a small labelled evaluation set.

title: GigBid technical prototype
content: A multi-agent-style freelance copilot with human approval, a local simulator, typed handoffs, and portfolio evidence retrieval.

title: Analytics proposal with scoped milestones
content: Used a short opening, named a relevant reporting workflow, and proposed a discovery milestone before committing to implementation detail.
